players.bio: Alex James Mowatt (born 13 February 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Derby County.

Bobby Lamont Clark is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Derby County. Clark trained with the academy at Birmingham City when his father, Lee Clark, was the manager there. The family moved back to the north east of England in 2014. After visiting all the clubs in the area Clark chose to join the academy at Newcastle United.

Carlton John Morris (born 16 December 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Derby County. He has had previous loan spells with Oxford United, York City, Hamilton Academical and Shrewsbury Town.

Charles James Taylor (born 18 September 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Derby County. Taylor is a product of the Leeds United academy and made his professional debut for the club in August 2011. He had loan spells with Bradford City, York City, Inverness Caledonian Thistle and Fleetwood Town. In 2017, Taylor joined Burnley.
Corey Josiah Paul Blackett-Taylor (born 23 September 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Derby County.

Craig Forsyth (born 24 February 1989) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a left-sided defender for English club Derby County. He previously played for Dundee before joining Watford in 2011, before joining Derby County in 2013. He has also had loan spells at Montrose, Arbroath, Bradford City and Derby County.

Cruz Anthony Allen is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for National League club FC Halifax Town, on loan from EFL Championship club Derby County. He is a Wales Under 19 international.

David Ikechukwu Ozoh (born 6 May 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for club Derby County. Born in Spain, he is a youth international for England. Starting his career at Crystal Palace, Ozoh made his first team debut in 2023, his first of 13 appearances for Crystal Palace.
Derry John Murkin (born 27 July 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Derby County.

Dion Dannie Leonard Sanderson is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Derby County. He began his career as a youngster with Wolverhampton Wanderers and later spent time on loan at Cardiff City, Sunderland, Birmingham City (two spells) and Queens Park Rangers, before leaving for Birmingham City in 2023.

Eiran Joe Cashin is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Derby County on loan from Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion. Cashin joined Derby County's academy and in 2018–19 was a part of Derby's U18 Premier League title success. In 2020, Cashin signed his first professional contract for Derby and in December 2021, he made his first team debut.
Filip Bilbija is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Derby County.

Jack Robinson is an English professional football defender who is currently a free agent. He made his senior debut for Liverpool at the age of 16 years and 250 days, which at the time made him the club's youngest ever player. He has also been capped by England at under-21 level.

Jacob Mikael Widell Zetterström (born 11 July 1998) is a Swedish footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Derby County. Widell Zetterström started his senior career in IFK Lidingö, joining Djurgårdens IF in 2019 and going on loan back to Lidingö the first season. Without having a place in the squad in 2020 due to head injury, he made his Djurgården debut in 2021.
Joseph Henry Ward (born 9 April 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Derby County .

John Mark Eustace (born 3 November 1979) is an English professional football coach and former player who is currently head coach of EFL Championship club Derby County. During his playing career, he played as a central midfielder for Coventry City, Stoke City, Watford and Derby County. He also spent time on loan at Dundee United, Middlesbrough and Hereford United.

Joshua Anthony Vickers (born 1 December 1995) is an English footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Derby County. Vickers began his career in the youth team at Arsenal. As a second-year scholar, he joined Isthmian League side Canvey Island on loan in August 2013, playing 30 league games, before returning to the Gunners and signing a professional contract.

Kenzo Goudmijn is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Derby County. On 7 January 2022, Goudmijn joined Excelsior on loan until the end of the season. The loan was extended for the 2022–23 season. Kenzo Goudmijn is the son of former AZ player Kenneth Goudmijn. Through his father, Goudmijn is of Surinamese descent.
Lars-Jørgen Salvesen (born 19 February 1996) is a Norwegian footballer who plays for Derby County as a striker.
Lewis Travis (born 16 October 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Derby County.
Matthew Edward Barkell Clarke (born 22 September 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central defender for EFL Championship club Derby

Max Johnston (born 26 December 2003) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Derby County and the Scotland national team. Johnston started his career at the Motherwell academy, making his senior debut in 2021, where also had loan spells at Queen of the South and Cove Rangers.
Mohammed Gadafi Fuseini is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Derby County, on loan from Belgian club Union Saint-Gilloise and the Ghana national team.

Nicholas Bilokapić is a 24-year-old Australian professional football goalkeeper who currently plays for EFL Championship club Derby County. Career Bilokapic began his career with Sydney United 58. He moved to English club Huddersfield Town, where he made his senior debut on 8 January 2022 in the FA Cup. He moved on loan to Hartlepool United on 31 January for the remainder of the 2021–2022 season.

Oscar Luigi Fraulo is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Derby County. Fraulo was born in Odense, Denmark to a family of Italian ancestry. He began playing football at an early age for OKS, before moving to the Midtjylland academy at age 13.

Owen Thomas Eames is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Falkirk, on loan from EFL Championship club Derby County. A youth product of Derby County, Eames made his first team debut in 2026, after signing his first professional contract in 2025.

Patrick K. Agyemang (born November 7, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Derby County and the United States national team. Career Youth Agyemang was born in East Hartford, Connecticut to Ghanaian parents. He attended East Hartford High School where he was a varsity starter in soccer for two years and was named all-conference in 2017.

Rhian Joel Brewster (born 1 April 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Derby County. In 2017, he was part of the England squad which won the 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup in India and was awarded the Golden Boot award for ending as the competition's leading goalscorer.

Richard Mark O'Donnell is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Derby County. Having started his career as a junior with Sheffield Wednesday he progressed to the first team where he was largely utilised as an understudy keeper in his years at Hillsborough.

Ryan Peter Hedges is a professional footballer who plays as a winger or left wing-back for EFL Championship club Derby County. Hedges spent 7 seasons at Everton FC eventually being released at U16. Hedges joined Swansea City from Flint Town in the summer of 2013 following some impressive performances for the Welsh Schools Under-18s team.
Ryan Nyambe (born 4 December 1997) is a Namibian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Derby County. He is also an International footballer for the Namibia national team as a defender.

Samuel Joseph Szmodics (born 24 September 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for EFL Championship club Derby County, on loan from Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in England, he plays for the Republic of Ireland national team.

Sondre Klingen Langås (born 2 February 2001) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Derby County and the Norway national team. Langås made his debut in the Norwegian Eliteserien for Viking. He made his debut for Norway in 2024.
